notes.title: A Game About Mowing Your Lawn
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SloaRLJn4Lk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Why mowing?[/b][/h3]
Mowing provides a sense of accomplishment, a way to connect with nature, a physical activity with immediate visible results, and can be a meditative routine. For many, it's also a way to unwind and de-stress.

        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535290/95794ff9af29fd0bef8de7b8669577cc273fa396.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535290/95794ff9af29fd0bef8de7b8669577cc273fa396.png[/img][/td]

[h3][b]Your Lawn. You Mower. And Mayhem?[/b][/h3]
Be cautious when mowing around lawns, previous residents left surprises buried beneath the grass. Ready to take the risk?

Each lawn you traverse brings new grass and new dangers. One wrong move, and your peaceful yard work could turn risky. How much can you mow?

[h3][b]Gameplay?[/b][/h3]
Mow 🚜 > Collect Grass 🍃 > Sell Grass 💰 > Upgrade your equipment ⚙️ > Toss Rocks 🗿 > Enjoy the scenery 🏔️
